faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Didn't find an answer? Message us — we reply quickly.

included.q: What is included in the rental price?
included.a: Mandatory insurance that covers carrying passengers, scheduled maintenance and unlimited mileage. Fuel and car washes are paid by the driver.

deposit.a: The €{deposit} deposit is refunded when you return the car. We inspect it together and, if there is no new damage or fines, refund the deposit the same day or within 3 working days by bank transfer.

accident.q: What if I have an accident?
accident.a: Call us immediately and, if needed, the police. Fill in the accident report and take photos of the scene. Liability is determined by the rental agreement and insurance terms.

abroad.a: Only with our prior written consent. Tell us which country you plan to visit and for how long.

extend.q: How do I extend the rental?
extend.a: Contact us before your rental period ends. If the car is free, we'll extend the rental and recalculate the price at the best tariff.

hourly.q: Can I rent by the hour?
hourly.a: Yes, economy cars can be rented for a few hours. The minimum duration and price are listed under “Prices”.

platform.q: How do I start working on a ride-hailing platform?
platform.a: You'll need a driving licence, a passenger transport permit and registration on the platform (e.g. Bolt). We'll explain every step and help you prepare the documents.

payment.q: How can I pay? Do you issue VAT invoices?
payment.a: You can pay by bank transfer or card. We issue invoices to companies and self-employed drivers.

requirements.a: At least {years} years of driving experience, aged {age}+, an ID document, a driving licence and a €{deposit} deposit. Requirements may be stricter for luxury cars.

documents.q: What should I bring when picking up the car?
documents.a: Your ID card or passport, driving licence and the deposit. We sign the agreement on the spot — it takes about 15 minutes.
